rows.description: HatchZip is a free, open-source archive extractor for Windows, macOS and Linux that extracts ZIP, 7z, RAR, tar and split archives in place, so it needs free space for the extracted files only. Desktop app and CLI.
JavaScript library to zip and unzip files supporting parallel compression, web streams, pluggable compression engines, zip64, split files, data encryption, and deflate64 decompression.
Swift framework for zipping and unzipping files.
